caveats: HK PARITY V2 + SAFE STAKING V1 is research/shadow only, not production-approved.
The selection thresholds were not changed for the safer version; only staking was reduced/reweighted.
Historical HKJC research/closing prices plus a 3% adverse-price stress are not the same as verified live accepted bookmaker prices.
The A$95.5k annual historical figure is not a forward income forecast; the calibrated model EV anchor is about A$19.9k/year.
The stored historical max drawdown is A$76k, but reorder stress remains materially larger; do not treat A$76k as a guaranteed maximum loss.
2026 is partial and must not be treated as a completed year.
Do not retune the frozen selection rule or SAFE stakes after future wins or losses simply to preserve backtest appearance.
